rationale: Represent the explicit incorporated material using DEVICE -> MATERIAL, without retyping graphene as DEVICE.

original_question.reason: Graphene MATERIAL integrated with an optical waveguide; frozen INTEGRATED_IN only permits DEVICE heads.

evidence.text: Moreover, benefiting from its two-dimensional nature, this atomically thick film with full flexibility has been widely incorporated with optical waveguides such as fibers, realizing novel photonic devices including polarizers, lasers, and sensors.

options.A: Представить INTEGRATED_IN после отдельного согласования схемы.
options.B: Сохранить существующую схему и учитывать как непокрытое отношение.

original_question.preliminary_recommendation: A для DEV при подтверждении семантики; B для CALIBRATION/HOLDOUT без изменения схемы.
